title: Two Monroe Homes 11-12 | Nashville Stay + Garage
description:
The ultimate Nashville group stay. Stay side-by-side in our stylish Monroe Homes — perfect for bachelorettes, wedding weekends, girls’ trips, family getaways, and group retreats. Enjoy the fun of staying together with the comfort, privacy, and elevated design of a boutique stay — not your typical party house.

This listing includes Monroe Homes 11 and 12, offering plenty of space for your group, plus private car garages and convenient parking for a stress-free stay.

Other things to note
Pet Policy:

We’re delighted to welcome your four-legged travel companion! We allow up to three dogs per stay for a fee of $150 per pet. To help us properly prepare for your arrival, please let us know in advance if you'll be bringing a dog with you.
